comments.content: The error from os.Rename is discarded and Save then returns nil. If the rename fails (permission denied, path is a directory, cross-device, etc.) the settings were not saved, yet the caller is told they were — contradicting the requirement that Save returns an error when settings were not saved. The orphaned .tmp file is also left behind. Return the rename error (and remove tmp on failure): `if err := os.Rename(tmp, path); err != nil { _ = os.Remove(tmp); return err }`.

The temporary file is written with os.WriteFile and renamed without ever being fsync'ed. After a crash or power loss the rename can be persisted before the data blocks, leaving an empty or truncated settings file — the very half-written state this change is meant to prevent. Write via os.CreateTemp/OpenFile, call f.Sync() and check f.Close() before renaming (and ideally sync the parent directory).
